From the analysis of Pr (x, vx) and In (x, Vx) for x close to 0 and x close to 1 it follows that if n ≤ 472 (resp. n ≥ 473) the determinant An;3 (x, vx) is negative (resp. positive) in a neighborhood of x = 0 and x = 1. Hence, to prove the Lemma, it is enough to check numerically that

The curve for n = 456 looks like a small ellipse around P = (0.098, v0.098), while the one for n = 874 looks like a small ellipse around Q = (0.97, V0.97).
